warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.desc: Tank & displacement. Broken Seal grants extra Barrier; Shove pushes a foe 1 tile; Slam (1/fight) hits all adjacent foes and knocks them back - into chasms if you line it up.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.desc: Rage: below half HP, melee hits deal +20% damage.

gladiator.name: Gladiator
gladiator.desc: Combo: each melee hit adds +10% damage (min +1 per stack, max 3 stacks).

mage.name: Mage
mage.unlock: Defeat Goo (Sewers boss) with any hero.
mage.desc: Zone control. The Mage's Staff fires its imbued wand as a bolt that ignores DR. The staff gains +1 charge at Lv7 (and every 7 levels).

battlemage.name: Battlemage
battlemage.desc: Melee hits with the staff deal +wand level bonus damage, and every 3rd melee hit restores 1 staff charge.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.desc: Soul siphon: staff bolts heal you for a third of the damage they deal; kills heal 20% of the foe's max HP.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.unlock: Reach floor 4 of the Sewers with any hero.
rogue.desc: Stealth & assassination. Cloak of Shadows (3 charges for the whole expedition, 1 back per cleared fight) hides you for 2 ticks: enemies lose track and your next hit is a Surprise (x1.5, more with a dagger). Keen eyes: spots hidden traps next to her as she moves and searches wider.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.desc: Surprise attacks deal +1x more (x2.5 instead of x1.5).

freerunner.name: Freerunner
freerunner.desc: Fast and slippery: attacks take 20% less time, +2 DR.

huntress.name: Huntress
huntress.unlock: Brew 5 potions at the Alchemy Pot.
huntress.desc: Geometry & overwatch. The Spirit Bow fires unlimited arrows at enemies past arm's length in line of sight (DR applies; Surprise when they lose sight of you). Searches a wider area for hidden traps.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: Spirit Bow shots +1 damage and ignore DR.

warden.name: Warden
warden.desc: Nature's aid: +4 Barrier, +2 DR. Spirit Bow surprise or grass shots pierce 50% DR. Ending a turn in tall grass heals 1 + level/8 HP.
